## Approval checklist

- [ ] The material is **approved for public use** and contains nothing confidential, under NDA, or still in draft
- [ ] Every fact (descriptions, dates, team, products, prices, contacts) **matches [solarityai.com](https://solarityai.com/)**
- [ ] It includes no numbers, users, or results that aren't published on the website
- [ ] File names are lowercase kebab-case with no spaces
- [ ] Images shown on a page are under about 500 KB, every file is under 1 MB, and larger masters go to a Release
- [ ] The folder `README.md` lists any new files
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated
